label: PF Backlog 36
title: 360-degree discovery panel: every lead agent asks clarifying questions (+recommendation)
body:
Built core/discovery_panel.py (owner of products/

/discovery-panel.json, kind=intake-raw): one question group per major agent, each lead representing its sub-agents (config/agent-hierarchy.json). Every question carries the agent's recommended answer; the human accepts it (blank/keep) or overrides. Wired into stage 0a (_run_design_augmentations + _ask_panel), synthesized via discovery_engine.synthesize_refined_idea -> docs/idea-refined.md + docs/product-plan.md, and injected into the discovery agent task so design/architect consume the crisp brief. Config: config/discovery-panel-settings.json (19 agents, cap 3, sub-agent rollup on). Tests: test-framework/tests/pipeline/test_discovery_panel.py. Fallback = curated questions when no LLM.

decisions.note: [P4] 360 discovery panel build (already wired; harden + tests).

dashboard_impact.reason: user-facing discovery surface exists (live 360-degree discovery panel)
